description: This file implements system information retrieval functions for the XB platform, including hardware version, serial number, MAC address, manufacturer, and model, with data cached from ARM-side scripts and files.

methods.name: shouldIgnoreLine
methods.description: Checks if a line from the script output is a comment or blank.

methods.name: copyAndTrimBuffer
methods.description: Copies characters from source to destination, trimming whitespace.

methods.name: loadFromArm
methods.description: Parses the ARM script output file to load hardware info into memory.

methods.name: initXb3
methods.description: Initializes the hardware info cache by loading data from ARM if not already loaded.

methods.name: hal_sysinfo_get_macaddr
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address from a file.

methods.name: hal_sysinfo_get_capability
methods.description: Checks if a capability is supported.

methods.name: hal_sysinfo_set_capability
methods.description: Enables a capability (not supported in this implementation).
